question: For order 423, identify the product IDs, aisles, and positions from which to pick the exact quantities needed for each order line, ensuring that the total picked quantity for each product matches the cumulative quantities ordered without exceeding the available inventory in warehouse 1. Calculate the quantities to be picked from each location by prioritizing inventory with earlier purchased dates and smaller quantities, and ensure that picking respects the sequence and cumulative quantities of the order lines for products with multiple entries.
sql:
WITH order_lines AS (
    SELECT order_id, product_id, SUM(qty) AS total_qty
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
    GROUP BY order_id, product_id
),
inventory_sorted AS (
    SELECT inv.id, inv.product_id, inv.purchase_id, inv.qty, inv.location_id, p.purchased, loc.warehouse, loc.aisle, loc.position,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased ASC, inv.qty ASC) AS rn
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN purchases p ON inv.purchase_id = p.id
    JOIN locations loc ON inv.location_id = loc.id
    WHERE loc.warehouse = 1
),
with_cumulative AS (
    SELECT inv.*, ol.total_qty,
           SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.purchased ASC, inv.qty ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_qty
    FROM inventory_sorted inv
    JOIN order_lines ol ON inv.product_id = ol.product_id
),
with_picking AS (
    SELECT *,
           CASE 
               WHEN cum_qty - total_qty < 0 THEN qty
               WHEN cum_qty - total_qty >= 0 AND (cum_qty - qty) - total_qty < 0 THEN total_qty - (cum_qty - qty)
               ELSE 0
           END AS pick_qty
    FROM with_cumulative
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, pick_qty AS qty_to_pick
FROM with_picking
WHERE pick_qty > 0
ORDER BY product_id, purchased, qty
